about_the_game:
“Lots of Cats in Every Moment: The Whereabouts of the Photo” is an expansion pack that contains the latter part of the story from the base game.

The kitten runs away with the photo…. Where did they hide it? Find the cats hidden in the beautiful and diverse hand-drawn landscapes and listen to their story, meow!

Find Over 1800 Cats and Special Items!

  • Part 1 (free): 5+α main landscapes, 5 interactable comic strips, 650+ cats, 250 items
  • Part 2 (DLC): 5+α main landscapes, 5 interactable comic strips, 650+ cats, 250 items

Main Features

  • All comic strips and main landscapes are connected through the story progression.
  • Has an original soundtrack, with unique tracks featured in each episode.
  • Hints can be used once every minute.
  • No penalty for clicking on a spot where there's no cat. Search freely.
